name: Ernesta Kühne
original_name: エルネスタ・キューネ
source: Ernesta is a student at Arlequint Academy, the school of technology, and the head of the Pygmalion Faction. Ernesta is shown to be peppy intellectual who enjoys a challenge, has a dark sense of humor, and is quite manipulative. She likes toying with her opponents as well as with her research subjects, giving them handicap without hesitating just for the fun of it.
